tests: Three levels of list nesting mixing ordered and unordered, where the third level has no list marker and is distinguished only by indentation and an em dash.
attacks: List structure recovery. Flattening the nesting loses the conditional logic entirely — 'Record the repeat even when unchanged' belongs under the NEWS2 3-or-4 branch, not as a peer of 'Assess the patient'. The markerless third level is the part a geometry-driven tagger is most likely to read as paragraphs.
title: Escalation Protocol

If NEWS2 is 3 or 4, repeat within the hour.
